description: This file declares the HostResolverSystemTask class and related functions for asynchronous DNS host resolution, including configuration parameters, callback types, and resolution methods, primarily used within Chromium's networking code.

classes.name: HostResolverSystemTask
classes.description: Manages asynchronous host resolution with retries, customizable parameters, and callback handling.

classes.name: HostResolverSystemTask.Params
classes.description: Configuration parameters for HostResolverSystemTask, including resolver procedure, retry attempts, delays, and retry factor.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a HostResolverSystemTask for a specific hostname with given parameters.

methods.name: CreateForOwnHostname
methods.description: Creates a HostResolverSystemTask to resolve the machine's own hostname.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Begins the resolution process, invoking the callback upon completion.

methods.name: was_completed
methods.description: Checks if the resolution has been completed.
